name: Exposure Type Aggregation 3
definition: Specifies the valuation details per exposure type aggregation.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Specifies the underlying business area/type of trade causing the exposure.

SettlementProcess.name: Settlement Process
SettlementProcess.definition: Specifies the settlement process in which the collateral will be settled.

ValuationAmounts.name: Valuation Amounts
ValuationAmounts.definition: Provides details on the collateral valuation.

MarginRate.name: Margin Rate
MarginRate.definition: The collateral excess/shortage expressed in the percentage of the collateral required.

GlobalExposureTypeStatus.name: Global Exposure Type Status
GlobalExposureTypeStatus.definition: Provides the status after comparing the total collateral required and the total collateral value of all transactions of the same exposure type.
